title: Agent transcript prose clips at ordinary panel width
impact: At a 420px panel, child transcript sentences lose their endings beyond the right edge. Maximizing to 960px reveals the complete text. Output arrival alone does not make the agent screen readable.
recommendation: Measure and wrap child prose against the actual panel content width; retain reading position across maximize, restore and resize. The precise layout cause remains to be isolated.
acceptance: Open a child with ordinary multi-sentence output at minimum and ordinary widths. Every character remains readable without maximizing; resizing and restoring reflow existing output without waiting for another event.
review_note: Parent inspected both screenshots. Source references locate the rendering path; they are not a proven root cause or proposed patch.

title: Browser retains a duplicate heading, nested tabs and legacy card beneath shared panel tabs
impact: The Browser surface row is followed by a second Browser title, a page-tab strip and then the toolbar. Repeated identities, differently scoped plus controls and competing frames consume space and make the existing browser look unfinished.
recommendation: Complete the shared surface model: give each page one clear identity and unify tab/control density; remove the redundant legacy Browser heading/card layer where the panel already provides it.
acceptance: Open one and two pages, switch to Files and back, and close the active page. Active identity and add/close scope remain clear, with a single deliberate panel hierarchy and aligned content edges.
review_note: Chrome observed in headless screenshots and personally in installed Ferrite with a loaded example.com page. The unavailable headless page body is expected and is not counted as a native browser-load defect. This is a visual-quality judgment supported by actual assembly and ADR 0039.

title: Empty browser address entry lacks a clear editable-region affordance
impact: The empty location row reads as navigation icons, a static Address label, blank space and a separate arrow. The editable region has no prompt; the label and annotation control also spend address width.
recommendation: Design one location control with explicit empty, idle, hover, focus, editing, loading and invalid states while preserving useful one-line address space.
acceptance: An empty tab clearly indicates where to enter a URL before interaction. Hover and keyboard focus identify the field; text and navigation remain usable at supported widths. Verify these native states individually.
review_note: Only empty presentation is directly observed here. Native hover/focus/narrow-width behavior remains unverified. T3 also uses a transparent idle field, so absence of a permanent border is not itself the defect.

title: Native PR read errors run beyond the panel and hide their cause and recovery text
impact: A long PR read error is centered on one unwrapped line wider than the panel. Its beginning and recovery instruction are clipped, leaving the operator unable to read the failure.
recommendation: Render read failures in a width-constrained, wrapping body with a visible relevant recovery action. Preserve the current PR identity and useful previous content.
acceptance: Force a long read error at ordinary/minimum panel widths. The full cause and next action remain readable and reachable; retry recovers without losing target identity.
review_note: Parent inspected the screenshot and the centered pr_note render path. The nonexistent synthetic repository caused this expected read error; it is not evidence that normal repositories fail.

title: Thread context lacks an independent compact details surface
impact: Thread context lives in Overview inside the full tabbed workspace panel, so checking it competes with Browser, Files, PR and other tools. Existing context controls do not provide a separate lightweight card alongside the active tool. This is distinct from remembered-width corruption.
recommendation: Provide independently accessible lightweight thread details, with separate visibility and responsive popover behavior, while preserving the active full tool surface and conversation reading space. Link agents to their main child conversations and Git/PR actions to explicit full-tool targets.
acceptance: Keep Browser, Files or PR open while showing and dismissing thread details. Pointer and Command-Shift-B target only details; Escape returns focus without closing the tool. Exercise narrow-size fallback, overflow, Find clearance, thread identity, live status, meaningful motion and reduced motion.
review_note: The inventory source links use the pinned newer comparison checkout. reports/thread-details-card-correction.md separately cites the exact installed revision and records native T3 identity, toggle, shortcut, one responsive mode transition, empty-workspace coexistence and Escape checks. Those T3 successes do not upgrade this Ferrite composition gap to runtime-reproduced. This finding was omitted from the earlier 176-record tally.
